title: Rexford Industrial Realty, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Rexford Industrial Realty, Inc. filed a Form 8-K current report disclosing Q1 2026 earnings results (quarter ended March 31, 2026) and amendments to its Code of Business Conduct and Ethics approved by the Board on April 21, 2026.
key_points: Rexford Industrial Realty is a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) focused on industrial properties in the Los Angeles area
The company issued a press release on April 23, 2026 announcing Q1 2026 earnings (quarter ended March 31, 2026)
The Board approved amendments to the company's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics on April 21, 2026 as part of ordinary course review
No waivers were granted to any officer, director, or employee under the amended code
Exhibits include the amended code of ethics (14.1), press release (99.1), and Q1 2026 supplemental financial report (99.2)
The CFO Michael Fitzmaurice signed the filing on behalf of the registrant
